verdict.rationale: Superhuman documents an official MCP server that lets Claude, ChatGPT and other assistants read, draft and send email, but nothing in the evidence shows issuing scoped or least-privilege API credentials for an agent. The closest items are adjacent controls: a human-approval gate on every send action and admin-level governance of connector permissions. Neither amounts to per-agent credentials with limited scopes, and the OpenAPI probes found no public API surface.
